title: Postdoctoral Positions in Statistics and the Mathematics of Insurance and Economics
institution: University of Copenhagen, Department of Mathematical Sciences
about: Postdoctoral positions of one to three years at the University of Copenhagen Department of Mathematical Sciences, covering statistics and the Section for Insurance and Economics, combining research with teaching (typically two half-semester courses per year). Start ordinarily 1 September 2027.
requirements: PhD (or proof of expected PhD date)
Application with CV, cover letter, diplomas and a 1-3 page research plan

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: "Statistics" (field) → "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."

"Statistics, insurance mathematics and economics" (field) → "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."; the course does not cover actuarial or insurance-specific mathematics
